result.question: What was Tesla's total revenue in fiscal year 2025?
result.answer: Tesla's total revenue for fiscal year 2025 was $94,827 million (approximately $94.8 billion), as reported in the Consolidated Statements of Operations in Tesla's 10-K filing for the year ended December 31, 2025 [0001628280-26-003952:item-8-p008]. This figure is also confirmed by the XBRL revenue fact of 94,827,000,000 USD for the period ending 2025-12-31 [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2025-12-31]. For context, this represented a decrease from $97,690 million in fiscal year 2024 and $96,773 million in fiscal year 2023 [0001628280-26-003952:item-8-p008].
